mission: Storage option B and D measurement (owner ask 2026-10-18 13:51Z): add a read-only official-image-repeats diagnostic that reports, per UTC day for the last 14 days, for the last 14 days and for all time, how many official card images retained by identity captures were already stored earlier with the same bytes (same content_hash) and how many the R2 official-image mirror already holds (card_print_image_assets sha256 equal to the recorded artwork_key). Register it in ops-readonly. Staging only; no rule, proposal, mapping, enqueue, collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: SELECT/WITH-only diagnostic (2 statements) over raw_snapshots (content_hash, pg_column_size only; no detoast), freshness_work resume_cursor and card_print_image_assets, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. No write, no source request.
Adds official-image-repeats to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (one new read-only SQL file)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156, #166 and #169
impact.deployment_impact: One new read-only diagnostic and a workflow choice entry. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes official-image-repeats and its workflow choice. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of the file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic official-image-repeats run completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries both statements' rows.

operational_notes: Identity-capture batches were paused 2026-10-17 15:41Z to 2026-10-18 13:57Z (owner decisions) and are RESUMED as before (owner confirmed 2026-10-18 14:16Z): each enqueue-remaining-50 ops-write batch is still dispatched as a dry run first and approved by the owner in the staging-ops Environment.
This diagnostic only measures storage options B and D (official images already stored, or already in the R2 mirror); no option is built or chosen by this change.
